To see a noticeable difference in your skin, it is recommended that you use the lotion regularly and consistently for 3-4 months. Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it Step 1 Pump out a generous amount of lotion Step 1 Massage an even layer all over the body until completely absorbed.
